title: Upper Intermediate
description: Understand the main ideas of complex texts, interact fluently and spontaneously, and write clear, detailed text explaining a viewpoint with its pros and cons.

id.title: Menengah Atas
id.description: Memahami ide utama teks kompleks, berinteraksi dengan lancar dan spontan, serta menulis teks yang jelas dan rinci sambil menjelaskan sudut pandang beserta kelebihan dan kekurangannya.

nodes.title: Narrative Tenses & Past Perfect Continuous
nodes.summary: Tell stories that mix past simple, past continuous, past perfect and past perfect continuous, plus would and used to for past habits.
nodes.canDo: Can tell a detailed story about past events, making the order of actions and background situations clear.

objectives.text: Combine past simple, past continuous and past perfect in one story
Use the past perfect continuous for actions in progress before a past moment (had been waiting)
Use would and used to for past habits, and used to for past states

commonErrors.wrong: When I arrived, the film already started.
commonErrors.right: When I arrived, the film had already started.

commonErrors.wrong: I waited for two hours when she finally came.
commonErrors.right: I had been waiting for two hours when she finally came.

commonErrors.wrong: When I was a child, I would have a bike.
commonErrors.right: When I was a child, I used to have a bike.

id.title: Narrative Tenses & Past Perfect Continuous
id.summary: Bercerita dengan memadukan past simple, past continuous, past perfect dan past perfect continuous, plus would dan used to untuk kebiasaan lampau.
id.canDo: Bisa menceritakan kejadian masa lalu secara rinci, dengan urutan kejadian dan latar yang jelas.

objectives.combine-past-tenses: Memadukan past simple, past continuous dan past perfect dalam satu cerita
objectives.past-perfect-continuous: Memakai past perfect continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung sebelum suatu waktu di masa lalu (had been waiting)
objectives.would-used-to-habits: Memakai would dan used to untuk kebiasaan lampau, serta used to untuk keadaan lampau

nodes.title: Future Continuous & Future Perfect
nodes.summary: Talk about actions in progress at a future time and actions that will be finished by a future deadline.
nodes.canDo: Can describe future plans precisely, saying what will be happening at a given time and what will have been done by then.

objectives.text: Use the future continuous for actions in progress at a future time (This time tomorrow I'll be flying)
Use the future perfect for actions completed by a future time (By 2030 I'll have finished)
Use the future perfect continuous for duration up to a future point (By June I'll have been working here for five years)

commonErrors.wrong: This time tomorrow I will fly to Bali.
commonErrors.right: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to Bali.

commonErrors.wrong: By 2030 I will finish my degree.
commonErrors.right: By 2030 I'll have finished my degree.

commonErrors.wrong: Call me when you will have finished.
commonErrors.right: Call me when you have finished.

id.title: Future Continuous & Future Perfect
id.summary: Membicarakan kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa depan dan hal yang sudah selesai sebelum tenggat tertentu.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan rencana ke depan dengan tepat: apa yang sedang kamu lakukan pada waktu tertentu dan apa yang sudah selesai saat itu.

objectives.future-continuous: Memakai future continuous untuk kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung di masa depan (This time tomorrow I'll be flying)
objectives.future-perfect: Memakai future perfect untuk hal yang sudah selesai sebelum waktu tertentu di masa depan (By 2030 I'll have finished)
objectives.future-perfect-continuous: Memakai future perfect continuous untuk durasi sampai titik tertentu di masa depan (By June I'll have been working here for five years)

nodes.title: Passive Voice
nodes.summary: Focus on the action, not the doer: the passive in all common tenses and with modals, plus passive reporting structures.
nodes.canDo: Can use the passive across tenses and in reporting structures to write clear, objective texts.

objectives.text: Form the passive in common tenses and with modals (has been sent, must be done)
Use passive reporting structures (It is said that …, He is believed to …)
Choose active or passive appropriately

commonErrors.wrong: The email has been send.
commonErrors.right: The email has been sent.

commonErrors.wrong: The accident was happened yesterday.
commonErrors.right: The accident happened yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: The report must be finish today.
commonErrors.right: The report must be finished today.

id.title: Kalimat Pasif
id.summary: Fokus pada tindakan, bukan pelakunya: kalimat pasif di semua tense umum dan dengan modal, plus pola passive reporting.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai kalimat pasif di berbagai tense dan pola pelaporan untuk menulis teks yang jelas dan objektif.

objectives.form-the-passive: Membentuk kalimat pasif dalam tense yang umum dan dengan modal (has been sent, must be done)
objectives.passive-reporting: Memakai pola passive reporting (It is said that …, He is believed to …)
objectives.choose-active-or: Memilih kalimat aktif atau pasif dengan tepat

nodes.title: Causative Have / Get
nodes.summary: Say that someone else does something for you: have/get something done for services like repairs and haircuts.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about services and arrangements where someone else does the work, such as repairs, deliveries and appointments.

objectives.text: Use have something done to talk about services (I had my hair cut)
Use get + object + past participle in informal speech (I need to get it fixed)
Talk about everyday services and bad experiences (I had my phone stolen)

commonErrors.wrong: I cut my hair at the barber's yesterday.
commonErrors.right: I had my hair cut at the barber's yesterday.

commonErrors.wrong: I got my laptop fix.
commonErrors.right: I got my laptop fixed.

commonErrors.wrong: I had repaired my car last week.
commonErrors.right: I had my car repaired last week.

id.title: Kalimat Kausatif Have / Get
id.summary: Menyatakan bahwa orang lain mengerjakan sesuatu untukmu: have/get something done untuk layanan seperti servis dan potong rambut.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan layanan dan urusan yang dikerjakan orang lain untukmu, seperti servis, pengiriman dan janji temu.

objectives.have-something-done: Memakai have something done untuk membicarakan layanan (I had my hair cut)
objectives.get-something-done: Memakai get + objek + V3 dalam percakapan santai (I need to get it fixed)
objectives.talk-about-services: Membicarakan layanan sehari-hari dan pengalaman buruk (I had my phone stolen)

nodes.title: Reported Speech
nodes.summary: Report questions and commands, use reporting verbs with the right pattern, and apply tense changes correctly.
nodes.canDo: Can accurately report what others said, asked or advised, choosing a suitable reporting verb.

objectives.text: Report questions and commands (She asked where I lived; He told me to wait)
Use reporting verbs with their patterns (suggest, warn, deny, admit, promise)
Report statements with full tense backshift, and know when it is optional

commonErrors.wrong: She asked me where do I live.
commonErrors.right: She asked me where I lived.

commonErrors.wrong: He suggested me to take a break.
commonErrors.right: He suggested taking a break. / He suggested that I take a break.

commonErrors.wrong: She told that she was tired.
commonErrors.right: She said that she was tired. / She told me that she was tired.

id.title: Kalimat Tidak Langsung
id.summary: Melaporkan pertanyaan dan perintah, memakai reporting verbs dengan pola yang benar, dan mengubah tense dengan tepat.
id.canDo: Bisa melaporkan dengan akurat apa yang dikatakan, ditanyakan atau disarankan orang lain, dengan reporting verb yang sesuai.

objectives.report-questions-and: Melaporkan pertanyaan dan perintah (She asked where I lived; He told me to wait)
objectives.reporting-verbs: Memakai reporting verbs beserta polanya (suggest, warn, deny, admit, promise)
objectives.report-statements-with: Melaporkan pernyataan dengan perubahan tense lengkap, dan tahu kapan perubahan itu boleh tidak dilakukan

nodes.title: Third & Mixed Conditionals
nodes.summary: Regrets and alternative pasts: imagine a different past and its results, then and now.
nodes.canDo: Can speculate about how things could have been different and how past events affect the present.

objectives.text: Talk about past hypotheticals (If I had known, I would have come)
Use mixed conditionals for present results (If I had studied IT, I would have a different job now)

commonErrors.wrong: If I knew about the meeting, I would have come.
commonErrors.right: If I had known about the meeting, I would have come.

commonErrors.wrong: If I would have studied harder, I would have passed.
commonErrors.right: If I had studied harder, I would have passed.

commonErrors.wrong: If I had taken that job, I would be live in Jakarta now.
commonErrors.right: If I had taken that job, I would be living in Jakarta now.

id.title: Third & Mixed Conditional
id.summary: Penyesalan dan masa lalu alternatif: membayangkan masa lalu yang berbeda dan akibatnya, dulu maupun sekarang.
id.canDo: Bisa berandai-andai tentang bagaimana sesuatu bisa berbeda dan bagaimana masa lalu memengaruhi masa kini.

objectives.talk-about-past: Membicarakan pengandaian di masa lalu (If I had known, I would have come)
objectives.use-mixed-conditionals: Menggunakan mixed conditional untuk akibat di masa kini (If I had studied IT, I would have a different job now)

nodes.title: Wish, If Only & Regrets
nodes.summary: Express wishes, regrets and criticism with wish, if only, should have, would rather and it's time.
nodes.canDo: Can express wishes, regrets and mild criticism about the present and the past.

objectives.text: Use wish / if only + past simple, past perfect or would
Use should have / shouldn't have to express regret and criticism
Use would rather and it's time + past simple

commonErrors.wrong: I wish I can speak Japanese.
commonErrors.right: I wish I could speak Japanese.

commonErrors.wrong: You shouldn't came late.
commonErrors.right: You shouldn't have come late.

commonErrors.wrong: It's time we go home.
commonErrors.right: It's time we went home.

id.title: Wish, If Only & Penyesalan
id.summary: Mengungkapkan harapan, penyesalan dan kritik dengan wish, if only, should have, would rather dan it's time.
id.canDo: Bisa mengungkapkan harapan, penyesalan dan kritik halus tentang masa kini maupun masa lalu.

objectives.wish-if-only: Memakai wish / if only + past simple, past perfect atau would
objectives.should-have: Memakai should have / shouldn't have untuk menyatakan penyesalan dan kritik
objectives.would-rather-its-time: Memakai would rather dan it's time + past simple

nodes.title: Modals of Deduction (Past)
nodes.summary: Draw conclusions about past events with must have, might have and can't have, and contrast needn't have with didn't need to.
nodes.canDo: Can make logical guesses about what happened in the past and explain how certain they are.

objectives.text: Use must have / might have / can't have + past participle
Distinguish needn't have done from didn't need to do
Make deductions about the past

commonErrors.wrong: He must went home already.
commonErrors.right: He must have gone home already.

commonErrors.wrong: She can't has seen it.
commonErrors.right: She can't have seen it.

commonErrors.wrong: I needn't have bring an umbrella.
commonErrors.right: I needn't have brought an umbrella.

id.title: Modal untuk Dugaan (Lampau)
id.summary: Menarik kesimpulan tentang kejadian lampau dengan must have, might have dan can't have, serta membedakan needn't have dan didn't need to.
id.canDo: Bisa membuat dugaan logis tentang apa yang terjadi di masa lalu dan menjelaskan seberapa yakin kamu.

objectives.past-modal-forms: Memakai must have / might have / can't have + V3
objectives.neednt-have-didnt-need: Membedakan needn't have done dan didn't need to do

nodes.title: Non-Defining & Reduced Relative Clauses
nodes.summary: Add extra information with non-defining clauses, use whose, whom and sentence-level which, and shorten clauses.
nodes.canDo: Can add detail to sentences with a range of relative clauses, punctuating them correctly.

objectives.text: Use non-defining relative clauses with commas
Use whose and whom, and which to refer to a whole clause
Use reduced relative clauses (the man standing there)

commonErrors.wrong: My father who lives in Bandung is a doctor.
commonErrors.right: My father, who lives in Bandung, is a doctor.

commonErrors.wrong: The company, that I work for, is growing.
commonErrors.right: The company, which I work for, is growing.

commonErrors.wrong: The man is standing there is my boss.
commonErrors.right: The man standing there is my boss.

id.title: Klausa Relatif Non-Defining & Ringkas
id.summary: Menambah informasi dengan non-defining clause, memakai whose, whom dan which untuk seluruh klausa, serta meringkas klausa.
id.canDo: Bisa menambahkan detail ke kalimat dengan berbagai klausa relatif dan tanda baca yang benar.

objectives.non-defining-commas: Memakai non-defining relative clause dengan koma
objectives.whose-whom-which: Memakai whose dan whom, serta which untuk merujuk seluruh klausa
objectives.reduced-relatives: Memakai reduced relative clause (the man standing there)

nodes.title: Participle Clauses
nodes.summary: Write shorter, more fluent sentences with -ing, -ed and having + past participle clauses.
nodes.canDo: Can combine ideas concisely using participle clauses in writing and prepared speech.

objectives.text: Use -ing clauses for simultaneous actions or reasons (Walking home, I saw …)
Use -ed clauses with a passive meaning (Built in 1990, …)
Use having + past participle for an earlier action (Having finished the report, I …)

commonErrors.wrong: Walking home, the rain started.
commonErrors.right: Walking home, I got caught in the rain.

commonErrors.wrong: Build in 1990, the bridge is still strong.
commonErrors.right: Built in 1990, the bridge is still strong.

commonErrors.wrong: After finish the report, I went home.
commonErrors.right: After finishing the report, I went home. / Having finished the report, I went home.

id.title: Klausa Partisip
id.summary: Menulis kalimat yang lebih ringkas dan lancar dengan klausa -ing, -ed dan having + V3.
id.canDo: Bisa menggabungkan ide secara ringkas dengan klausa partisip dalam tulisan dan presentasi.

objectives.ing-clauses: Memakai klausa -ing untuk kegiatan yang bersamaan atau alasan (Walking home, I saw …)
objectives.ed-clauses: Memakai klausa -ed yang bermakna pasif (Built in 1990, …)
objectives.having-past-participle: Memakai having + V3 untuk kegiatan yang terjadi lebih dulu (Having finished the report, I …)

nodes.title: Verb Patterns That Change Meaning
nodes.summary: Learn verbs whose meaning changes with -ing or to, the difference between used to and be/get used to, and verb + object + to.
nodes.canDo: Can choose the right verb pattern so that the meaning is exactly what you intend.

objectives.text: Use remember, forget, stop and try + -ing vs + to with the right meaning
Distinguish used to from be/get used to + -ing
Use verb + object + to-infinitive (want him to …, ask her to …)

commonErrors.wrong: I'm used to wake up early.
commonErrors.right: I'm used to waking up early.

commonErrors.wrong: She wants that I come to the party.
commonErrors.right: She wants me to come to the party.

commonErrors.wrong: I stopped to smoke last year. (meaning I quit)
commonErrors.right: I stopped smoking last year.

id.title: Pola Kata Kerja yang Mengubah Makna
id.summary: Mempelajari kata kerja yang maknanya berubah dengan -ing atau to, beda used to dan be/get used to, serta kata kerja + objek + to.
id.canDo: Bisa memilih pola kata kerja yang tepat sehingga maknanya persis seperti yang kamu maksud.

objectives.ing-vs-to-meaning: Memakai remember, forget, stop dan try + -ing vs + to dengan makna yang tepat
objectives.used-to-vs-be-used-to: Membedakan used to dan be/get used to + -ing
objectives.verb-object-infinitive: Memakai kata kerja + objek + to-infinitive (want him to …, ask her to …)

nodes.title: Articles & Quantifiers in Depth
nodes.summary: Know when to use no article, the, and quantifiers like each, every, either, neither, both and none.
nodes.canDo: Can use articles and quantifiers accurately when talking about things in general and in particular.

objectives.text: Use no article for general meaning (Life is …, Children need …)
Use the for specific or unique things
Use each, every, either, neither, both and none correctly

commonErrors.wrong: The life is hard.
commonErrors.right: Life is hard.

commonErrors.wrong: Every students has a laptop.
commonErrors.right: Every student has a laptop.

commonErrors.wrong: Neither of my friends didn't come.
commonErrors.right: Neither of my friends came.

id.title: Artikel & Quantifier Lebih Dalam
id.summary: Tahu kapan tidak memakai artikel, kapan memakai the, dan quantifier seperti each, every, either, neither, both dan none.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai artikel dan quantifier dengan akurat saat membicarakan hal secara umum maupun spesifik.

objectives.zero-article-general: Tidak memakai artikel untuk makna umum (Life is …, Children need …)
objectives.the-specific-unique: Memakai the untuk hal yang spesifik atau unik
objectives.quantifiers: Memakai each, every, either, neither, both dan none dengan benar

nodes.title: Linking & Discourse Markers
nodes.summary: Connect ideas with linkers like whereas, nevertheless, consequently and despite, and build clear paragraphs.
nodes.canDo: Can link ideas clearly in speech and writing to show contrast, cause, result and addition.

objectives.text: Connect ideas with contrast, cause, result and addition linkers (whereas, nevertheless, consequently, despite)
Organise a paragraph clearly

commonErrors.wrong: Although it was raining, but we went out.
commonErrors.right: Although it was raining, we went out.

commonErrors.wrong: Despite of the traffic, we arrived on time.
commonErrors.right: Despite the traffic, we arrived on time.

commonErrors.wrong: Despite it rained, the event continued.
commonErrors.right: Although it rained, the event continued. / Despite the rain, the event continued.

id.title: Kata Penghubung & Penanda Wacana
id.summary: Menghubungkan ide dengan penghubung seperti whereas, nevertheless, consequently dan despite, serta menyusun paragraf yang jelas.
id.canDo: Bisa menghubungkan ide dengan jelas secara lisan maupun tulisan untuk menunjukkan kontras, sebab, akibat dan tambahan.

objectives.connect-ideas-with: Menghubungkan ide dengan penghubung kontras, sebab, akibat dan tambahan (whereas, nevertheless, consequently, despite)

nodes.title: Collocations
nodes.summary: Use natural word partnerships: adjective + noun, verb + noun and adverb + adjective, especially at work.
nodes.canDo: Can use common collocations so that speech and writing sound natural, especially in work contexts.

objectives.text: Use adjective + noun collocations (heavy traffic, strong coffee)
Use verb + noun collocations (meet a deadline, raise an issue)
Use adverb + adjective collocations (highly unlikely, fully aware)

commonErrors.wrong: The traffic is very crowded today.
commonErrors.right: The traffic is very heavy today.

commonErrors.wrong: We have to reach the deadline.
commonErrors.right: We have to meet the deadline.

commonErrors.wrong: It's strongly unlikely.
commonErrors.right: It's highly unlikely.

id.title: Kolokasi
id.summary: Memakai pasangan kata yang alami: kata sifat + kata benda, kata kerja + kata benda, dan adverb + kata sifat, terutama di dunia kerja.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai kolokasi umum agar ucapan dan tulisan terdengar alami, terutama dalam konteks kerja.

objectives.adjective-noun: Memakai kolokasi kata sifat + kata benda (heavy traffic, strong coffee)
objectives.verb-noun: Memakai kolokasi kata kerja + kata benda (meet a deadline, raise an issue)
objectives.adverb-adjective: Memakai kolokasi adverb + kata sifat (highly unlikely, fully aware)

nodes.title: Word Formation in Depth
nodes.summary: Build new words with negative prefixes, noun/adjective/adverb suffixes and compounds.
nodes.canDo: Can build and recognise word families to expand vocabulary and understand new words.

objectives.text: Use negative prefixes correctly (im-, ir-, il-, in-, un-, dis-)
Form nouns, adjectives and adverbs with suffixes (-ment, -ness, -ful, -ive, -ly)
Understand and use compound words (deadline, user-friendly, workplace)

commonErrors.wrong: It's unpossible.
commonErrors.right: It's impossible.

commonErrors.wrong: That was very unresponsible.
commonErrors.right: That was very irresponsible.

commonErrors.wrong: He is very success.
commonErrors.right: He is very successful.

id.title: Pembentukan Kata Lebih Dalam
id.summary: Membentuk kata baru dengan prefix negatif, suffix kata benda/kata sifat/adverb, dan kata majemuk.
id.canDo: Bisa membentuk dan mengenali keluarga kata untuk memperkaya kosakata dan memahami kata baru.

objectives.negative-prefixes: Memakai prefix negatif dengan benar (im-, ir-, il-, in-, un-, dis-)
objectives.suffixes: Membentuk kata benda, kata sifat dan adverb dengan suffix (-ment, -ness, -ful, -ive, -ly)
objectives.compound-words: Memahami dan memakai kata majemuk (deadline, user-friendly, workplace)

nodes.title: Phrasal Verbs & Common Idioms
nodes.summary: Use separable, inseparable and three-part phrasal verbs, plus common everyday idioms.
nodes.canDo: Can understand and use common phrasal verbs and idioms in everyday conversation.

objectives.text: Distinguish separable and inseparable phrasal verbs (pick it up, look after her)
Use three-part phrasal verbs (look forward to, come up with)
Understand and use common idioms (break the ice)

commonErrors.wrong: I look forward to meet you.
commonErrors.right: I look forward to meeting you.

commonErrors.wrong: Can you pick up me at seven?
commonErrors.right: Can you pick me up at seven?

commonErrors.wrong: She came up a great idea.
commonErrors.right: She came up with a great idea.

id.title: Phrasal Verb & Idiom Umum
id.summary: Memakai phrasal verb yang bisa dipisah, tidak bisa dipisah dan tiga kata, plus idiom sehari-hari yang umum.
id.canDo: Bisa memahami dan memakai phrasal verb dan idiom umum dalam percakapan sehari-hari.

objectives.separable-inseparable: Membedakan phrasal verb yang bisa dan tidak bisa dipisah (pick it up, look after her)
objectives.three-part: Memakai phrasal verb tiga kata (look forward to, come up with)
objectives.common-idioms: Memahami dan memakai idiom umum (break the ice)

nodes.title: Formal vs Informal Vocabulary
nodes.summary: Choose between formal and informal words, such as phrasal verbs vs Latin-based verbs, to suit your reader.
nodes.canDo: Can adjust vocabulary to the reader and situation, switching between formal and informal register.

objectives.text: Use formal equivalents of everyday words (get → obtain, ask → enquire)
Choose between a phrasal verb and a Latin-based verb (find out → discover)
Match word choice to the reader and situation

commonErrors.wrong: Hi Sir, I wanna ask about the job.
commonErrors.right: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to enquire about the position.

commonErrors.wrong: Dear Mr Budi, (surname is Santoso)
commonErrors.right: Dear Mr Santoso,

commonErrors.wrong: Thanks a lot, see ya!
commonErrors.right: Thank you for your help. Kind regards,

id.title: Kosakata Formal vs Informal
id.summary: Memilih kata formal atau informal, misalnya phrasal verb vs kata kerja Latin, sesuai dengan pembaca.
id.canDo: Bisa menyesuaikan kosakata dengan pembaca dan situasi, berganti antara register formal dan informal.

objectives.formal-equivalents: Memakai padanan formal untuk kata sehari-hari (get → obtain, ask → enquire)
objectives.phrasal-vs-latin: Memilih antara phrasal verb dan kata kerja Latin (find out → discover)
objectives.match-the-reader: Menyesuaikan pilihan kata dengan pembaca dan situasi

nodes.title: Work, Business & Money
nodes.summary: Vocabulary for meetings, projects, deadlines, basic finance and how organisations are structured.
nodes.canDo: Can talk about projects, budgets and roles at work using precise business vocabulary.

objectives.text: Talk about meetings, projects and deadlines
Use basic finance words (budget, revenue, cost, profit)
Describe roles and organisational structure (report to, department, team lead)

commonErrors.wrong: We need to discuss about the budget.
commonErrors.right: We need to discuss the budget.

commonErrors.wrong: The company got a big profit this year.
commonErrors.right: The company made a big profit this year.

commonErrors.wrong: I am responsible to the marketing team.
commonErrors.right: I am responsible for the marketing team.

id.title: Kerja, Bisnis & Keuangan
id.summary: Kosakata untuk rapat, proyek, tenggat, keuangan dasar dan struktur organisasi.
id.canDo: Bisa membicarakan proyek, anggaran dan peran di tempat kerja dengan kosakata bisnis yang tepat.

objectives.basic-finance: Memakai kosakata keuangan dasar (budget, revenue, cost, profit)
objectives.roles-structure: Menjelaskan peran dan struktur organisasi (report to, department, team lead)

nodes.title: Science, Environment & Society
nodes.summary: Vocabulary for science and innovation, climate change and energy, and discussing social issues neutrally.
nodes.canDo: Can discuss science, the environment and social issues with suitable vocabulary and a balanced tone.

objectives.text: Talk about science, research and innovation
Talk about climate change and energy (emissions, renewable, carbon footprint)
Discuss social issues in neutral, balanced language

commonErrors.wrong: The climate change is a big problem.
commonErrors.right: Climate change is a big problem.

commonErrors.wrong: There are many researches about it.
commonErrors.right: There is a lot of research on it.

commonErrors.wrong: Pollution makes the environment broken.
commonErrors.right: Pollution damages the environment.

id.title: Sains, Lingkungan & Masyarakat
id.summary: Kosakata untuk sains dan inovasi, perubahan iklim dan energi, serta membahas isu sosial secara netral.
id.canDo: Bisa membahas sains, lingkungan dan isu sosial dengan kosakata yang tepat dan nada yang berimbang.

objectives.climate-energy: Membicarakan perubahan iklim dan energi (emissions, renewable, carbon footprint)
objectives.social-issues-neutral: Membahas isu sosial dengan bahasa yang netral dan berimbang

nodes.title: Connected Speech
nodes.summary: Understand and use elision, assimilation and weak forms in fast speech, and recognise gonna, wanna and gotta.
nodes.canDo: Can follow fast, natural speech and link words smoothly when speaking.

objectives.text: Recognise and use elision and assimilation (next door, ten people)
Use weak forms in fast speech (to, for, and, can)
Recognise gonna, wanna and gotta and know they are informal

commonErrors.wrong: Every word said fully and separately: 'I – am – going – to – go'
commonErrors.right: Linked with weak forms: 'I'm going tə go' /aɪm ˈɡəʊɪŋ tə ɡəʊ/

commonErrors.wrong: Hearing 'gonna' and not recognising 'going to'
commonErrors.right: gonna = going to, wanna = want to, gotta = have got to (informal speech only)

commonErrors.wrong: Writing 'I wanna ask' in a work email
commonErrors.right: Writing 'I would like to ask' (gonna/wanna/gotta are for speech)

id.title: Connected Speech
id.summary: Memahami dan memakai elision, assimilation dan weak forms dalam ucapan cepat, serta mengenali gonna, wanna dan gotta.
id.canDo: Bisa mengikuti ucapan alami yang cepat dan menyambung kata dengan lancar saat berbicara.

objectives.elision-assimilation: Mengenali dan memakai elision dan assimilation (next door, ten people)
objectives.weak-forms-fast: Memakai weak forms dalam ucapan cepat (to, for, and, can)
objectives.gonna-wanna-gotta: Mengenali gonna, wanna dan gotta serta tahu bahwa bentuk ini informal

nodes.title: Intonation, Contrastive Stress & Chunking
nodes.summary: Use intonation to show attitude, stress words to correct or contrast, and pause in chunks when presenting.
nodes.canDo: Can use intonation, stress and pausing to show attitude and make key points clear to listeners.

objectives.text: Use intonation to show attitude (doubtful, surprised, polite)
Use contrastive stress (I said TUESday, not THURSday)
Pause and chunk speech clearly when presenting

commonErrors.wrong: Flat intonation everywhere, so 'Really?' sounds bored
commonErrors.right: A wide rise on 'Really?' to sound genuinely surprised

commonErrors.wrong: Equal stress on every word: 'I said Tuesday, not Thursday'
commonErrors.right: Extra stress on the contrast: 'I said TUESday, not THURSday'

commonErrors.wrong: Reading a slide in one long breath without pauses
commonErrors.right: Pausing between chunks: 'Last year | our sales | rose by ten percent'

id.title: Intonasi, Contrastive Stress & Chunking
id.summary: Memakai intonasi untuk menunjukkan sikap, memberi tekanan untuk mengoreksi atau membandingkan, dan memberi jeda saat presentasi.
id.canDo: Bisa memakai intonasi, tekanan dan jeda untuk menunjukkan sikap dan memperjelas poin penting bagi pendengar.

objectives.intonation-attitude: Memakai intonasi untuk menunjukkan sikap (ragu, terkejut, sopan)
objectives.contrastive-stress: Memakai contrastive stress (I said TUESday, not THURSday)
objectives.pausing-chunking: Memberi jeda dan memenggal ucapan (chunking) dengan jelas saat presentasi

nodes.title: Extended Listening & Accents
nodes.summary: Follow lectures, talks and podcasts, track arguments and attitude, handle UK/US/AU accents and take notes.
nodes.canDo: Can follow extended talks and lectures on familiar topics, including the speaker's argument and attitude, in common accents.

objectives.text: Understand long lectures, talks and podcasts
Follow the speaker's argument and attitude
Understand UK, US and Australian accents
Take useful notes while listening

id.title: Menyimak Panjang & Aksen
id.summary: Mengikuti kuliah, talk dan podcast, menangkap argumen dan sikap pembicara, memahami aksen UK/US/AU dan mencatat.
id.canDo: Bisa mengikuti kuliah dan pembicaraan panjang tentang topik yang dikenal, termasuk argumen dan sikap pembicara, dalam aksen yang umum.

objectives.long-talks-podcasts: Memahami kuliah, talk dan podcast yang panjang
objectives.uk-us-au-accents: Memahami aksen Inggris (UK), Amerika (US) dan Australia (AU)

nodes.title: Reading Strategies & Inference
nodes.summary: Skim and scan quickly, infer meaning and the writer's attitude, and read long reports and opinion articles.
nodes.canDo: Can read long, complex texts efficiently, understanding implied meaning and the writer's point of view.

objectives.text: Skim and scan texts quickly
Infer implied meaning and the writer's attitude
Read long reports and opinion articles

id.title: Strategi Membaca & Inferensi
id.summary: Skimming dan scanning dengan cepat, menyimpulkan makna tersirat dan sikap penulis, serta membaca laporan dan artikel opini panjang.
id.canDo: Bisa membaca teks panjang dan kompleks secara efisien, memahami makna tersirat dan sudut pandang penulis.

objectives.skim-scan: Skimming dan scanning teks dengan cepat
objectives.inference-attitude: Menyimpulkan makna tersirat dan sikap penulis
objectives.long-reports-opinion: Membaca laporan dan artikel opini yang panjang

nodes.title: Discussions
nodes.summary: Take part in spontaneous discussions: weigh pros and cons, speculate and take turns naturally.
nodes.canDo: Can take an active part in discussions, giving and weighing arguments and speculating about possibilities.

objectives.text: Take part in a spontaneous discussion
Weigh up pros and cons
Speculate about possibilities (I'd imagine …, It could be that …)
Take turns naturally and invite others to speak

commonErrors.wrong: I am agree with you.
commonErrors.right: I agree with you.

id.title: Diskusi
id.summary: Ikut diskusi spontan: menimbang kelebihan dan kekurangan, berspekulasi dan bergiliran bicara dengan wajar.
id.canDo: Bisa berperan aktif dalam diskusi, menyampaikan dan menimbang argumen, serta berspekulasi tentang kemungkinan.

objectives.speculate: Berspekulasi tentang kemungkinan (I'd imagine …, It could be that …)
objectives.turn-taking: Bergiliran bicara dengan wajar dan mengajak orang lain berbicara

nodes.title: Small Talk & Networking
nodes.summary: Start and keep up conversations with colleagues and new contacts, pick safe topics and end conversations politely.
nodes.canDo: Can start, keep up and politely end small talk with colleagues and new professional contacts.

objectives.text: Start and keep up a conversation with colleagues and new contacts
Tell safe topics from sensitive ones
Close a conversation politely

commonErrors.wrong: So, how much is your salary?
commonErrors.right: So, how long have you been working there?

id.title: Small Talk & Networking
id.summary: Memulai dan menjaga obrolan dengan kolega dan kenalan baru, memilih topik aman, dan menutup percakapan dengan sopan.
id.canDo: Bisa memulai, menjaga dan menutup small talk dengan sopan bersama kolega dan kenalan profesional baru.

objectives.start-keep-conversation: Memulai dan menjaga obrolan dengan kolega dan kenalan baru
objectives.safe-sensitive-topics: Membedakan topik yang aman dan yang sensitif

nodes.title: Participating in Meetings
nodes.summary: Interrupt, clarify and summarise politely, and give clear updates in meetings.
nodes.canDo: Can contribute effectively to meetings: interrupting politely, clarifying points and giving updates.

objectives.text: Interrupt and hold the floor politely
Clarify and summarise points
Give a clear progress update

commonErrors.wrong: Sorry, I want to cut.
commonErrors.right: Sorry to interrupt, but could I just add something?

id.title: Berpartisipasi dalam Rapat
id.summary: Menyela, mengklarifikasi dan merangkum dengan sopan, serta menyampaikan update yang jelas dalam rapat.
id.canDo: Bisa berkontribusi secara efektif dalam rapat: menyela dengan sopan, mengklarifikasi poin dan menyampaikan update.

objectives.interrupt-and-hold: Menyela dan mempertahankan giliran bicara dengan sopan

nodes.title: Describing Graphs & Data
nodes.summary: Describe trends and compare figures in graphs and charts, and write a graph report in IELTS Writing Task 1 style.
nodes.canDo: Can describe and compare the main trends in graphs and charts clearly in writing.

objectives.text: Use trend vocabulary (rise, fall, peak, fluctuate)
Compare figures accurately (twice as high, slightly lower than)
Write a graph report in IELTS Writing Task 1 format (at least 150 words)

commonErrors.wrong: Sales increased until 20%.
commonErrors.right: Sales increased to 20%. / Sales increased by 20%.

commonErrors.wrong: The number of users was increase.
commonErrors.right: The number of users increased.

id.title: Mendeskripsikan Grafik & Data
id.summary: Mendeskripsikan tren dan membandingkan angka dalam grafik dan diagram, serta menulis laporan grafik ala IELTS Writing Task 1.
id.canDo: Bisa mendeskripsikan dan membandingkan tren utama dalam grafik dan diagram secara tertulis dengan jelas.

objectives.trend-vocabulary: Memakai kosakata tren (rise, fall, peak, fluctuate)
objectives.compare-figures: Membandingkan angka dengan akurat (twice as high, slightly lower than)
objectives.graph-report: Menulis laporan grafik dengan format IELTS Writing Task 1 (minimal 150 kata)

nodes.title: Giving Presentations
nodes.summary: Signpost the structure, explain data with visuals and handle audience questions.
nodes.canDo: Can give a clear, well-structured presentation with visuals and handle questions from the audience.

objectives.text: Signpost the structure of a talk
Explain data and trends using visuals
Handle audience questions

commonErrors.wrong: Okay, next. This is the graph.
commonErrors.right: Let's move on to the results. As you can see in this graph, …

id.title: Presentasi
id.summary: Menandai struktur, menjelaskan data dengan visual dan menjawab pertanyaan audiens.
id.canDo: Bisa membawakan presentasi yang jelas dan terstruktur dengan visual, serta menjawab pertanyaan audiens.

objectives.describe-trends-and: Menjelaskan data dan tren dengan bantuan visual

nodes.title: Job Interviews
nodes.summary: Talk about experience with concrete examples, answer behavioural questions with STAR, and discuss strengths and goals.
nodes.canDo: Can present experience, strengths and career goals convincingly in a job interview.

objectives.text: Describe experience with concrete examples
Answer behavioural questions with the STAR method
Talk about strengths and career goals

commonErrors.wrong: I have worked here since three years.
commonErrors.right: I have worked here for three years.

id.title: Wawancara Kerja
id.summary: Menjelaskan pengalaman dengan contoh konkret, menjawab pertanyaan perilaku dengan STAR, dan membicarakan kekuatan serta tujuan.
id.canDo: Bisa menyampaikan pengalaman, kekuatan dan tujuan karier secara meyakinkan dalam wawancara kerja.

objectives.answer-behavioural-questions: Menjawab pertanyaan perilaku dengan metode STAR

nodes.title: Opinion & Discursive Essays
nodes.summary: Write well-organised opinion and discursive essays with arguments and counter-arguments, in B2 First and IELTS formats.
nodes.canDo: Can write a clear essay that develops an argument, giving reasons for and against a point of view.

objectives.text: Structure an essay with an introduction, body paragraphs and a conclusion
Develop arguments and respond to counter-arguments
Write exam essays to length: B2 First (140–190 words) and IELTS Writing Task 2 (at least 250 words)

commonErrors.wrong: In my opinion, I think that …
commonErrors.right: In my opinion, … / I believe that …

id.title: Esai Opini & Diskursif
id.summary: Menulis esai opini dan diskursif yang tertata dengan argumen dan kontra-argumen, dalam format B2 First dan IELTS.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis esai yang jelas dan mengembangkan argumen, dengan alasan yang mendukung maupun menentang suatu pendapat.

objectives.essay-structure: Menyusun esai dengan pembuka, paragraf isi dan penutup
objectives.exam-essays: Menulis esai ujian sesuai panjangnya: B2 First (140–190 kata) dan IELTS Writing Task 2 (minimal 250 kata)

nodes.title: Formal Emails & Reports
nodes.summary: Write formal emails, letters and short reports with headings in an appropriate register.
nodes.canDo: Can write clear formal emails, letters and short reports in a suitable register.

objectives.text: Write in a formal register
Write formal emails and letters (requests, complaints, applications)
Structure a short report with section headings

commonErrors.wrong: I want to ask about the training schedule.
commonErrors.right: I am writing to enquire about the training schedule.

id.title: Email & Laporan Formal
id.summary: Menulis email, surat dan laporan singkat dengan judul bagian dalam register formal yang tepat.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis email, surat dan laporan singkat yang jelas dengan register yang sesuai.

objectives.formal-emails-letters: Menulis email dan surat formal (permintaan, keluhan, lamaran)
objectives.structure-a-short: Menyusun laporan singkat dengan judul di tiap bagian

nodes.title: Reviews & Articles
nodes.summary: Write reviews of films, products and apps with a recommendation, and articles with an engaging title and opening.
nodes.canDo: Can write engaging reviews and articles that describe, evaluate and recommend.

objectives.text: Write a review (film, product, app) with a clear recommendation
Write an article with an engaging title and opening

commonErrors.wrong: I recommend you to watch it.
commonErrors.right: I recommend watching it. / I'd recommend that you watch it.

id.title: Review & Artikel
id.summary: Menulis review film, produk dan aplikasi dengan rekomendasi, serta artikel dengan judul dan pembuka yang menarik.
id.canDo: Bisa menulis review dan artikel menarik yang mendeskripsikan, menilai dan memberi rekomendasi.

objectives.write-reviews: Menulis review (film, produk, aplikasi) dengan rekomendasi yang jelas
objectives.write-articles: Menulis artikel dengan judul dan pembuka yang menarik

nodes.title: Explaining Data & Summarising Texts
nodes.summary: Explain graphs and data aloud, summarise long articles (Indonesian or English) for a given audience, and help a group work together.
nodes.canDo: Can explain data and summarise long texts for a specific audience, and help a group work together towards a goal.

objectives.text: Explain graphs and data orally
Summarise a long article (Indonesian or English) for a specific audience
Facilitate group work (invite views, keep the task on track)

id.title: Menjelaskan Data & Meringkas Teks
id.summary: Menjelaskan grafik dan data secara lisan, meringkas artikel panjang (ID/EN) untuk audiens tertentu, dan membantu kerja kelompok.
id.canDo: Bisa menjelaskan data dan meringkas teks panjang untuk audiens tertentu, serta membantu kelompok bekerja sama mencapai tujuan.

objectives.explain-data-orally: Menjelaskan grafik dan data secara lisan
objectives.summarise-for-audience: Meringkas artikel panjang (bahasa Indonesia atau Inggris) untuk audiens tertentu
objectives.facilitate-group-work: Memfasilitasi kerja kelompok (mengajak semua berpendapat, menjaga tugas tetap terarah)

nodes.title: B2 Checkpoint
nodes.summary: A mixed test of all B2 strands in a format similar to B2 First and IELTS.
nodes.canDo: Can show B2-level skills across grammar, vocabulary, listening, reading, writing and speaking.

objectives.text: Grammar and vocabulary: B2 structures, collocations and word formation
Listening and reading: new long texts, including inference and attitude
Writing: an essay or formal text of the right length and register
Speaking: a discussion and a short talk (B2 First / IELTS style)

id.title: Checkpoint B2
id.summary: Tes campuran semua strand B2 dengan format mirip B2 First dan IELTS.
id.canDo: Bisa menunjukkan kemampuan level B2 di grammar, kosakata, listening, reading, writing dan speaking.

objectives.grammar-vocabulary: Grammar dan kosakata: struktur B2, kolokasi dan pembentukan kata
objectives.listening-reading: Listening dan reading: teks panjang baru, termasuk inferensi dan sikap
objectives.writing: Writing: esai atau teks formal dengan panjang dan register yang tepat
objectives.speaking: Speaking: diskusi dan presentasi singkat (gaya B2 First / IELTS)
